downstream_qa.question: A desktop 2.4 client sends a 14 MiB ZIP that expands to 160 MiB; a web client sends a 19 MiB PDF. Decide both outcomes and the rejection envelope.
expected_answer_concepts: Reject the 14 MiB ZIP because 160 MiB exceeds the expanded cap, with HTTP 422 and the 2.4 string error envelope.
A 19 MiB PDF meets the size cap but still requires format and access checks.
Use streaming size validation and private transactional blob ownership.
Storage growth cannot be quantified without real upload volume and size distribution.
